name: banner
title: Banner
description: One line across the top of a page for news everyone on it should have.
use: A release, planned maintenance or an incident that everyone on a page or a panel should know about. Write one sentence and at most one link. A banner that stays is any element with a role that matches its urgency; one that can be dismissed is a dialog with open and banner-dismissible.

instead.when: The message belongs to one task or one part of the page
It reports one event that just happened and may leave by itself
The reader must answer before going on

platform.feature: A dialog with the open attribute, dismissed by a form with method="dialog"
platform.fallback: The banner is in the page from the first paint and its button closes it without script. To remember the dismissal, a script listens for the dialog's close event and the page is then rendered without open
A dismissed banner leaves at once instead of folding away

classes.name: banner
classes.description: The band: the tray tone with a hairline under it. An icon inside takes the band's tone

classes.name: banner-dismissible
classes.description: On a dialog with open: the band folds away to nothing when the dialog closes. Without open it is not shown

classes.name: banner-info
classes.description: A faint tint and icon in the info hue

classes.name: banner-success
classes.description: A faint tint and icon in the success hue

classes.name: banner-warning
classes.description: A faint tint and icon in the warning hue

classes.name: banner-danger
classes.description: A faint tint and icon in the danger hue

classes.name: banner-inverse
classes.description: A band of ink, for the one announcement of a release

classes.name: banner-brand
classes.description: A band of the brand color; with it on the page, no other brand surface belongs in the view

classes.name: banner-content
classes.description: The message, centered in the band: an icon, the words and one action, wrapping as a group

classes.name: banner-title
classes.description: The few strong words that carry the news

classes.name: banner-action
classes.description: The one link out, underlined in the band's text color

classes.name: banner-close
classes.description: The form with method="dialog", or the button, that dismisses the banner, at the far end of the band

states.name: open
states.description: The banner is shown. Leave it out when the reader has dismissed the banner before

properties.name: --banner-tone
properties.description: The icon color, and the hue of a tint

example: Atlas 4 is here. Faster builds and a new dashboard. Read the notes
